summary: Vylor Inc. filed an 8-K on October 1, 2026 reporting the completion of its spin-off from Corteva, Inc. via a pro rata distribution of all Vylor common shares to Corteva holders as of the September 24, 2026 record date. Vylor becomes an independent, NYSE-listed company under symbol VYLR, commencing regular-way trading October 1, 2026. No price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or break fee was disclosed. The distribution mechanics create potential index-inclusion and forced-selling overhangs. Watch for initial trading dynamics, index eligibility, and any subsequent strategic actions by the newly independent seed company.
